design_philosophy: PathForge AI acts as a stealthy, hyper-intelligent 'Operating System' for a student's career. The aesthetic is strictly Black and Dark Grey, evoking the feeling of a premium, hyper-focused command center (Jarvis-like). No distractions, no vivid colors. Depth is created purely through typography scaling, 1px grey borders, and subtle white glow effects.

data_and_ai.usage: Used for Forge AI (Jarvis) chat text, roadmap nodes, CGPA metrics, and skill-gap percentages.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle CSS grain/noise overlays over the #000000 base to kill digital flatness. It should look like matte metal.
visual_enhancers.borders: Exposed grid borders. Use `border-collapse` style where cards touch, or 1px `border-white/10` to delineate zones.
visual_enhancers.glow: Use drop-shadow on active states instead of background colors. Example: `drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)]` for active roadmap nodes.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: No heavy glassmorphism for data panels. Use flat #0A0A0A solid surfaces to ensure data charts do not refract visually.

component_rules.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Flat black background, 1px solid white border, white text. On hover: Invert to white background and black text.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. bg-[#0A0A0A], border-white/10, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white. No blue focus rings.
component_rules.cards: Cardless or flat rectangular. Generous padding (`p-6` or `p-8`). Use `border border-white/10`.
component_rules.charts: Shadcn/Recharts. STRICTLY monochromatic. Use varying opacities of white/grey for bar and radar charts.
component_rules.forge_ai_companion: A fixed drawer/sidebar (Jarvis style). Pure black background, monospace typography. Proactive suggestions pulse subtly (`animate-pulse` on a 1px border ring).
component_rules.roadmap_canvas: Node-based visual map. Unlocked nodes are bright white. Locked nodes are #333333. Paths between them are dashed 1px lines (`border-white/20`). Add a custom cursor for panning.
component_rules.student_profile: Radar charts using `#FFFFFF` for the polygon stroke, and `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)` for the fill.
component_rules.general: Do NOT use HTML components for advanced user interactions. Use Shadcn components for Select, Tabs, Dialogs.

grids.dashboard_bento: High-density Mode B. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Gap `gap-4` or `gap-6`. Every pixel utilized. The 'Today\'s Plan' spans 2 columns, 'Forge AI Suggestions' spans 1 tall column.
grids.landing_hero: Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical layout prioritizing visual tension.

layouts.navigation: Sticky top nav (`z-50`). Solid `bg-black/90` with `backdrop-blur-md` and a 1px `border-b border-white/10`.
layouts.spacing: Use generous scales: `p-6`, `p-8`, `p-12`. Do not cram content.
layouts.alignment: Left-align data, labels, and forms. Center-align only the main landing page hero statement.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions. Example: `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`, NEVER `transition-all`.
motion.hover_states: Must invert colors or noticeably shift lightness (e.g., text from #A3A3A3 to #FFFFFF, border from white/10 to white/40).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets on load.
motion.ai_active: Subtle breathing/pulsing effect (`scale 1.0` to `1.02` with 2s duration) on the Forge AI notification icon.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence. White text on black is maximum contrast. Grey text (#A3A3A3) on #0A0A0A passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a sharp 1px white outline with an offset (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black`).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="roadmap-node-1"`, `data-testid="forge-ai-drawer"`).

media.hero_overlay: Images must have heavy `bg-black/70` to `bg-black/80` overlays so the bright white text remains highly legible.
media.treatment: Desaturate images slightly (grayscale filter) to match the black and grey aesthetic.

3d_libraries.recommendation: React Flow (for the node-based roadmap canvas). Visx or Recharts for the Student Intelligence Profile radar/bar charts.

landing_hero_background.description: College student focused late at night, perfectly encapsulating the target audience's grind.
landing_hero_background.usage: Landing page hero background with a very heavy black gradient overlay.

ai_intelligence_bg.usage: Use as a subtle textured background inside the Forge AI companion drawer or the Student Intelligence Profile cards.

roadmap_texture.usage: Background texture for the interactive Roadmap canvas (set to 5% opacity).

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use gradients unless it's a fade-to-black mask. Adhere strictly to the black and dark grey palette.
For the roadmap node canvas, use standard DOM elements inside a pannable container if React Flow is too complex, but maintain the technical node aesthetic.
The Forge AI component should feel like an integrated terminal overlay. Use monospace fonts for its outputs.
Implement the multi-step onboarding wizard using standard state management but make the transitions seamless. Hide standard HTML form inputs behind customized Shadcn UI elements.
Always apply optical alignment over geometric alignment. For instance, adjust padding when using icons.
All cards must have a `p-6` or `p-8` spacing and a `border-white/10`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' outputs. Use stark contrasts and brutalist geometric alignments.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center-align app containers (`text-align: center`). Left align everything except specific hero messaging.
Use pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. In this app, prioritize sharp or max 4px rounded corners.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath without a solid or heavily blurred backdrop.
Examine and reuse existing components from `src/components/ui/` where applicable.
